note: Pre-listed rule family (design §7.2 rule 2), fixed before any signal-outcome association was computed. A rule fires at the first request k (1-based) whose pre-request state satisfies any of its conditions, at most once. Router signals (k, prompt_tokens, spend_usd, compactions) come from the proxy call log and cover every run; body signals come from the rollout (signals.py) and never fire for a run without one. 'ge_kq' = the given quantile of the source arm's calls per run on the tune split of the same benchmark; 'ge_const' = a named constant. Both are resolved by `simulate.py freeze` from outcome-free data and recorded in FROZEN.json.

constants.R8_spend: 2 × the median per-run ledger cost of the source arm (F) over its tune-split runs, per benchmark

router_compaction: compactions = the number of calls j < k whose prompt is below 0.6 × the largest prompt since the previous detected compaction (core's compaction:shrink rule, policy.compaction.shrinkRatio 0.6)

selection.split: experiments/assessor-v22/heldout/split.jsonl (sha256 daac972f3906fe2308c71922e9ad2e7e2ff1d27ccbe7f4b75d4d75922948aa2a); select on tune, gate once on heldout
selection.SA: maximise M2 ΔR vs pinned Sol (A) subject to fire rate ≤ 0.25 on Sol-resolved runs; ties → lower overall fire rate
selection.FS: maximise M2 ΔR vs pinned Sol (A) subject to the gate (high) cost ratio vs pinned Sol ≤ 0.60; ties → lower overall fire rate
selection.basis: DeepSWE: resolved. TB: primary (§7.7, a lookup-flagged resolved run counts as unresolved); as-graded as the sensitivity

late_fire: a run that fires with less than 15% of its agent timeout left (timeout − seconds from its first call to call k) keeps its own outcome under M1, M2 and M2_self

scenarios.M2_self: y + (1 − y)·p_S^{−j}(t), leave-one-out over the other source runs of the task

costs.splice: π + u_k + output_k at target price + Σ_{i>k} usage_i repriced at target prices
costs.tail: π + u_k + mean over the target's runs of task t of Σ_{i>k} their call costs (0 past their end)
costs.π: Σ_{i<k} call cost, scaled to the run's ledger total
costs.u_k: prompt tokens of request k × the target's 30m cache-write price (a cold switch, nothing read from cache)
